home.privacySubtitle: We take the security of your health information seriously.
home.privacy1Desc: Your screener answers are only shared with a licensed agent if you ask to be connected. Our free articles carry standard display ads; the screener and your results never do.
home.privacy2Desc: All data is transmitted over HTTPS. We never collect Social Security numbers, bank information, or medical records.
home.privacy3Desc: Check your eligibility without signing up. Your screener results are not stored unless you request agent help.
home.faq1A: Yes, completely. CoveredUSA never charges users. We're funded by licensed insurance agents who pay us only if you choose to connect with them, and only after you enroll.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to sign up or create an account?
home.faq2A: No account, no email, no sign-up required. Answer the questions, see your results. That's it.
home.faq3Q: What health insurance programs do you check?
home.faq3A: We screen for Medicaid, ACA Marketplace plans (including subsidies), Medicare, Medicare Savings Programs, and CHIP for children.
home.faq4A: No. CoveredUSA is a private company. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency, including CMS, HHS, or the federal Medicare program.
home.faq5Q: Will I be pressured to buy something?
home.faq5A: No. We show you your eligibility results with no strings attached. If you want help enrolling, we can connect you with a licensed agent, but that's always your choice.
home.faq6A: Our entire screener is available in Spanish, and we can connect you with Spanish-speaking licensed agents.
home.ctaTitle: Don't leave money on the table.
home.ctaSubtitle: Millions of Americans qualify for health coverage they don't know about. Find out in 2 minutes — it's free.
home.ctaNote: No sign-up. No pressure. Just results.

privacyPage.advertisingBody: Our articles and guides show display ads served by Google AdSense. Google and its partners set advertising cookies on those pages and may use them to show you ads based on your visit to this site and other sites. We do not give advertising partners your name, email, screener answers or health information. The screener, your results, and the bill analyzer never load advertising. You can opt out of personalized advertising at adssettings.google.com, and California residents can opt out of the sharing of personal information for advertising through the Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information link in our footer.

doNotSellPage.advertisingNote: Advertising cookies on our article pages may also count as sharing under California law. Those cookies never receive your name, your email, or your screener answers. You can opt out of personalized advertising directly with Google at adssettings.google.com.

contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.metaDescription: How to reach CoveredUSA with a question, a correction, or a privacy request.
contactPage.intro: CoveredUSA is run by a small team. Email is the fastest way to reach us, and we read everything.
contactPage.emailBody: Write to the address below. We answer most messages within two business days.
contactPage.correctionsBody: If a number or a rule in one of our guides looks wrong, send us the page and the line. We check it against the source and fix it.
contactPage.privacyBody: To access, correct, or delete the information we hold about you, use the same address. We respond within 30 days.
contactPage.notGovHeading: We are not a government agency
contactPage.notGovBody: CoveredUSA cannot take or process your application. For help with an application you can always visit HealthCare.gov, visit Medicare.gov, or call 1-800-MEDICARE.

editorialPage.title: How we write and check our guides
editorialPage.metaDescription: How CoveredUSA guides are researched, checked against primary sources, updated, and paid for.
editorialPage.p1: CoveredUSA publishes guides to health coverage costs and eligibility: Medicare, Medicaid, ACA marketplace plans, and what procedures and drugs cost. This page explains how they are made.
editorialPage.p2: Our guides are drafted with the help of AI writing tools and checked against the primary source before they are published: the federal or state agency page, the regulation, or the official rate table the guide is about.
editorialPage.p3: Every guide shows the date it was published and the date it was last updated. When a federal figure changes, such as the poverty guidelines or Medicare premiums, the guides that use it are re-checked.
editorialPage.p4: Jacob Posner, the founder, is responsible for the content on this site. CoveredUSA is not affiliated with any government agency.
editorialPage.p5: If you find an error, email us with the page and the line and we will correct it.
editorialPage.p6: The site is free to use. It is paid for by display advertising on article pages and by referral fees when someone chooses to connect with a licensed agent. Neither changes what a guide says or what the screener shows.
